personalInfo.name: Roberto Abad Ramirez Nieves
personalInfo.title: Senior Software Engineer
personalInfo.description: Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience building scalable, high-impact digital products across mobile and web platforms. Strong background in iOS, modern frontend architectures, API integration, and enterprise-grade applications used by millions of users.

about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I am a software engineer focused on building reliable, scalable, and well-crafted digital products in complex and high-impact environments, including banking, enterprise platforms, and consumer-facing applications.

My experience spans across native iOS development, modern frontend technologies, and backend service integration, allowing me to contribute beyond feature delivery — from architecture discussions and system design to performance, accessibility, and long-term maintainability.

I thrive in collaborative environments where technology, product, and design intersect, and I am known for adapting quickly to new stacks and domains while maintaining a strong engineering mindset focused on quality, clarity, and user value.

items.title: Senior iOS Engineer (Contract via Enhance IT)
items.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
description: Collaborated onsite at Wells Fargo’s Silicon Valley hubs (Fremont / San Leandro) to lead development of native features for the Wells Fargo iOS banking app, impacting millions of daily users.
Led the migration of legacy WebView-based flows to fully native Swift and SwiftUI implementations, significantly improving performance, reliability, and user experience.
Pioneered the adoption of Apollo GraphQL CLI to modernize the API layer; first engineer on the team to implement GraphQL architecture in production.
Delivered inclusive and accessible user interfaces compliant with strict banking QA and accessibility standards (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, external keyboard support).
Collaborated closely with Android, QA, Backend, and Design teams within Agile Scrum environments to deliver bi-weekly releases.

items.title: iOS Developer Consultant (Bootcamp & Training)
description: Completed an immersive, high-intensity iOS development bootcamp focused on advanced SwiftUI, Combine, and enterprise-grade architectural patterns.
Trained in modern iOS architectures including MVVM-C and VIPER through hands-on projects and technical evaluations.
Received specialized training in communication and soft skills for U.S. corporate environments.
Prepared for enterprise client deployment through mock projects simulating large-scale banking applications.

items.title: Full Stack Developer

Designed and implemented backend services using .NET Core APIs integrated with SQL Server databases and stored procedures.
Built and maintained a native Android application integrating API services for real-time warehouse operations and reporting.
Designed SQL stored procedures for operational reporting and analytics.

items.title: Java / Spring Full Stack Developer

Mentored junior engineers and supported ongoing development efforts across multiple projects.
